name: tree-of-thoughts
title: Search for a Game of 24 solution, with the machine checking every step

origin.source: LangGraph Tree of Thoughts tutorial (Game of 24)

comparison.purpose: A model proposes arithmetic steps toward 24, and a beam search keeps the three most promising lines for up to three steps. The machine re-derives every step, rejects any that uses a number not on the table or gets the arithmetic wrong, and only reports a solution it checked itself. No solution ends in a failed state with the reason.

starters.label: Unsolvable — 1, 1, 1, 1 (every line dies, ends in failed)
